raw.rationale: PP-1 is a Src-family kinase inhibitor with activity against HCK and RET, but at 2.5 µM for 5 days it is unlikely to show strong lineage-selective killing; Src-family dependencies are broad and rarely lineage-restricted, and RET-driven selectivity would mainly be expected in thyroid (not listed) or a small subset of lung cancers. Published PRISM-type screens generally show low selective hit rates (0.2–2.5% per lineage), so probabilities are kept low with slight enrichment for lung and CNS due to RET/Src pathway involvement.
